mapper.select: select usrc.couponsUserId, u.userName, c.couponsName, c.couponsPrice, c.couponsThreshold, c.effectiveDate, c.invalidDate, c.state as mainState, usrc.state as secondState from `user` u left join usercoupons usrc on u.userId = usrc.userId left join coupons c on c.couponsId = usrc.couponsId where u.userName = #{userName} and c.del = 0 order by c.effectiveDate desc

select usrc.couponsUserId, u.userName, c.couponsName, c.couponsPrice, c.couponsThreshold, c.effectiveDate, c.invalidDate, c.state as mainState, usrc.state as secondState from `user` u left join usercoupons usrc on u.userId = usrc.userId left join coupons c on c.couponsId = usrc.couponsId where u.userName = #{userName} and c.state = 1 and usrc.state = 0 and c.couponsThreshold <= #{totalPrice} and c.del = 0 and current_date between c.effectiveDate and date_add(c.invalidDate, interval 1 day )

select usrc.couponsUserId, u.userName, c.couponsName, c.couponsPrice, c.couponsThreshold, c.effectiveDate, c.invalidDate, c.state as mainState, usrc.state as secondState from `user` u left join usercoupons usrc on u.userId = usrc.userId left join coupons c on c.couponsId = usrc.couponsId where usrc.couponsUserId = #{couponsType}
select * from coupons where couponsId not in (select usercoupons.couponsId from usercoupons where usercoupons.userId = #{userId}) and state = 1 and del = 0
select * from ordering_sys.coupons where couponsName like "%"#{couponsName}"%" and del = 0
